items.title: Can a Radar-Equipped AC Actually Cut Your Power Bill?
items.excerpt: AI-powered air conditioners from LG, Samsung and Dyson now use radar to track occupants room to room; WIRED tests whether 'AI Direct/Indirect Wind' and AI energy modes actually save power.
items.rationale: Hands-on test of radar-sensing AI air conditioners from LG/Samsung/Dyson; a fresh home-appliance AI angle from a new outlet, replacing the Alexa shopping pick that marketing keeps.

items.title: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
items.excerpt: Tau Robotics is sending humanoid robots to clean San Francisco homes; they still need lots of remote human guidance but are learning.
items.rationale: First-hand account of a paid humanoid home-cleaning service leaving pilot; strongest outlet in the Tau cluster (Gadgeteer duplicate dropped).

items.title: Syncere Lume robot lamp folds laundry and makes the bed for $2,699
items.excerpt: Syncere's Lume is a $2,699 floor lamp hiding a robot arm with onboard perception and local AI compute that folds laundry, makes the bed and tidies; lifetime autonomy costs $679, invite-only deliveries in H1 2027.
items.rationale: Novel product announcement with pricing; on-device AI is the core of the device, and its form factor is a striking design idea.

items.title: Motorola's new earbuds are gunning for AirPods with Bose sound and some handy AI features
items.excerpt: Motorola's Moto Buds Ultra 27 (Moto Buds 2 Ultra) pair Bose-tuned audio with live AI translation and gesture controls to take on AirPods Pro and Galaxy Buds 4 Pro.
items.rationale: New hardware launch with live AI translation; adds a wearables/audio slot to the mix and is unrelated to the Galaxy Buds hands-on it loosely matched.

items.title: HomeView will support third-party AI chatbots, suggests code
items.excerpt: Code in the iOS 27.3 beta suggests Apple's HomeView smart home hub will gain support for third-party AI chatbots alongside Siri.
items.rationale: New iOS 27.3 beta finding: third-party chatbots on Apple's smart display, a different capability from the published Siri-to-third-party-apps story.
